message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a festive-article crown. Halloween costume headwear is generally classified in Chapter 95 as festive articles (9505.90.60), unless it is a wearing apparel item of textile. Note 1(e) to Chapter 95 excludes... actually, Chapter 95 does not cover "fancy dress of textiles, of chapters 61 and 62," but a headpiece of textile would go in Chapter 65 only if it is a hat. Notably, Chapter 65 excludes "fancy dress headwear"? Note 1(c) to Chapter 65 excludes dolls' hats and other toy or carnival articles of Chapter 95. So a carnival article crown goes to 9505.90.6000 (other festive, carnival or other entertainment articles, other).
